lineage_catalog.label: Industrial design

lineage_catalog.label: Technology evolution
lineage_catalog.ask: Always-on networks, background compute, push, local vs cloud agents, battery and attention budgets.

lineage_catalog.label: Graphic / visual communication
lineage_catalog.ask: Status typography, dashboards, iconography, density vs glanceability.

lineage_catalog.label: Architecture / spatial

lineage_catalog.label: Accessibility

lineage_catalog.label: Social / cultural behavior

seeds.observed_example: Sketchpad-like graphical workspace where points, lines, and constraints are manipulated with a pointing device.
seeds.problem_or_conditions: Make geometric design visible and interactive instead of repeatedly describing it textually.
seeds.enabling_technology_or_constraints: Interactive display, pointing hardware, incremental graphics, and limited compute.
seeds.interaction_form: Direct manipulation with selection and immediate visual feedback.
seeds.remembered_reaction_or_critique: Foundational and intuitive, but expensive hardware and narrow task scope limited reach; MEDIUM confidence.
seeds.suspected_source_or_example: HCI history, demonstrations, and retrospective teaching material.
seeds.uncertainty: MEDIUM—canonical form is clear, while implementation details blur.
seeds.relevance_clue: Visible state and reversible actions can make delegated work inspectable.
seeds.coding_agent_bias: Coding-agent training may overvalue manipulable artifacts and underweight embodied access.

seeds.observed_example: Time-sharing terminals gave users an ongoing text session on shared remote compute.
seeds.problem_or_conditions: Improve over batch submission by providing continuity of control and incremental feedback.
seeds.enabling_technology_or_constraints: Shared CPUs, terminals, operating-system scheduling, and scarce compute resources.
seeds.interaction_form: Session-based text interaction with commands, prompts, and responses.
seeds.remembered_reaction_or_critique: More responsive than batch, but queues, disconnections, and hidden system state remained frustrating; MEDIUM confidence.
seeds.uncertainty: MEDIUM—general pattern is stable, but examples and chronology are blended.
seeds.relevance_clue: Persistent conversational control still needs visible ownership and runtime state.
seeds.coding_agent_bias: Training may treat terminal continuity as the default and understate nontechnical users’ barriers.

seeds.observed_example: Short asynchronous text messages delivered to constrained mobile phones and later organized into threads.
seeds.problem_or_conditions: Coordinate without requiring a live call or shared schedule.
seeds.enabling_technology_or_constraints: Cellular networks, small displays, tiny keyboards, store-and-forward delivery, and limited bandwidth.
seeds.interaction_form: Compose, send, receive notification, and reply asynchronously.
seeds.remembered_reaction_or_critique: Low friction and socially powerful, but interruptions and missing context can create pressure; LOW confidence.
seeds.uncertainty: MEDIUM—form and tradeoffs are familiar, but reactions vary by culture and era.
seeds.relevance_clue: Asynchronous agent commands need durable replies, context, and interruption policy.
seeds.coding_agent_bias: Chat-with-tools training may overestimate text’s ability to carry urgency and context.

seeds.observed_example: Cockpit-like panels with dedicated switches, knobs, guarded controls, and status annunciators.
seeds.problem_or_conditions: Prevent mode errors and support rapid action under stress.
seeds.enabling_technology_or_constraints: Reliable physical controls, tactile feedback, instrument panels, and high-consequence operations.
seeds.interaction_form: Physical selection, tactile confirmation, guarded activation, and visual status checking.
seeds.remembered_reaction_or_critique: Dedicated controls aid confidence, while alarm overload and mode confusion remain persistent; MEDIUM confidence.
seeds.suspected_source_or_example: Aviation human-factors practice and incident studies.
seeds.uncertainty: MEDIUM—cockpit patterns are clear, but specific reactions are generalized.
seeds.relevance_clue: High-impact agent actions benefit from explicit modes, confirmations, and safe guards.
seeds.coding_agent_bias: Software examples can flatten physical affordances into buttons and miss tactile or embodied cues.

seeds.observed_example: Always-connected phones and cloud services perform background synchronization and push notifications.
seeds.problem_or_conditions: Avoid stale polling and preserve service continuity across intermittent attention.
seeds.enabling_technology_or_constraints: Mobile networks, cloud infrastructure, event delivery, background execution, battery, and attention budgets.
seeds.interaction_form: Background event processing with notification-driven re-entry.
seeds.remembered_reaction_or_critique: Convenient continuity increased attention drain and made background state opaque; LOW confidence.
seeds.suspected_source_or_example: Platform history and engineering discussions of push and sync.
seeds.uncertainty: MEDIUM—technology pattern is familiar, but causal effects are broad generalizations.
seeds.relevance_clue: Agents can outlive a conversation, requiring clear background activity and interruption boundaries.
seeds.coding_agent_bias: Coding-agent training may assume abundant compute, network access, and battery.

seeds.observed_example: Operational displays use typography, symbols, color, hierarchy, and compact status summaries for scanning.
seeds.problem_or_conditions: Make changing information understandable at a glance without reading every detail.
seeds.enabling_technology_or_constraints: Display technology, visual conventions, limited attention, and varying viewing distances.
seeds.interaction_form: Visual scan followed by selective focus and drilldown.
seeds.remembered_reaction_or_critique: Dense hierarchy can be glanceable, but color-only coding and badge overload fail users; LOW confidence.
seeds.uncertainty: MEDIUM—principles are stable, while specific examples vary.
seeds.relevance_clue: Agent status should remain legible under glance-level attention and detailed inspection.
seeds.coding_agent_bias: Coding-agent training may favor monospace logs, diff colors, and status badges over broader visual access.

seeds.observed_example: Control rooms and war rooms arrange people, maps, displays, and communication channels around shared work.
seeds.problem_or_conditions: Coordinate attention, responsibility, and decisions across a complex operation.
seeds.enabling_technology_or_constraints: Shared physical presence, wall displays, dedicated stations, and communication infrastructure.
seeds.interaction_form: Move between stations, inspect shared surfaces, confer, and hand off responsibility.
seeds.remembered_reaction_or_critique: Shared overview helps coordination, but centralized rooms can create theater and exclude remote participants; MEDIUM confidence.
seeds.uncertainty: MEDIUM—spatial pattern is clear, critique is interpretive.
seeds.relevance_clue: Persistent agent work may need zones for ownership, evidence, and escalation rather than one stream.
seeds.coding_agent_bias: Repository and workspace metaphors may overfit physical-room analogies.

seeds.observed_example: Screen readers and keyboard navigation expose semantic structure and focus order without relying on vision or pointing.
seeds.problem_or_conditions: Enable interaction for blind, low-vision, motor-limited, and cognitively diverse users.
seeds.enabling_technology_or_constraints: Semantic markup, speech synthesis, keyboard focus, assistive technologies, and accessibility standards.
seeds.interaction_form: Linear focus traversal, commands, announcements, and recoverable navigation.
seeds.remembered_reaction_or_critique: Essential when semantics are preserved; dynamic unlabeled updates and focus loss remain common failures; LOW confidence.
seeds.suspected_source_or_example: Accessibility standards, user reports, and assistive-technology practice.
seeds.uncertainty: MEDIUM—general accessibility requirements are well known, examples are unsourced.
seeds.relevance_clue: Agent controls must expose state, changes, and recovery paths across modalities.
seeds.coding_agent_bias: Coding datasets overrepresent visual desktop and keyboard workflows.

seeds.observed_example: Assistants, dispatchers, and coordinators triage requests between principals and the wider group.
seeds.problem_or_conditions: Protect attention while distributing work and preserving social accountability.
seeds.enabling_technology_or_constraints: Role norms, shared channels, organizational hierarchy, and trust in intermediaries.
seeds.interaction_form: Request, triage, delegate, escalate, acknowledge, and report back.
seeds.remembered_reaction_or_critique: Trusted intermediaries reduce interruption, but authority and credit can become ambiguous; MEDIUM confidence.
seeds.uncertainty: HIGH—pattern is broad and culturally variable.
seeds.relevance_clue: Delegated agent work needs visible requester, authority, responsibility, and escalation etiquette.
seeds.coding_agent_bias: Coding-agent training may reduce social delegation to tickets, assignees, and roles.

seeds.observed_example: Unix-like shells combine commands, pipelines, background jobs, signals, terminals, and textual output.
seeds.problem_or_conditions: Compose powerful operations and let work continue beyond the immediate foreground interaction.
seeds.enabling_technology_or_constraints: TTYs, process models, pipes, files, signals, and modest interfaces.
seeds.interaction_form: Enter commands, detach or foreground jobs, inspect stdout, and respond to errors.
seeds.remembered_reaction_or_critique: Powerful and reproducible, but dangerous flags, weak discoverability, and opaque process state remain risks; LOW confidence.
seeds.uncertainty: MEDIUM—core mechanisms are canonical, details vary across shells.
seeds.relevance_clue: Agent actions need explicit lifecycle controls and evidence beyond a final text response.
seeds.coding_agent_bias: This lineage is likely overrepresented because coding agents are trained on CLI use.

seeds.observed_example: Industrial control rooms combine overview displays, alarm panels, trend views, and operator intervention points.
seeds.problem_or_conditions: Monitor many signals while distinguishing routine status from conditions requiring action.
seeds.enabling_technology_or_constraints: Sensors, supervisory systems, wall displays, dedicated operators, and alarm channels.
seeds.interaction_form: Scan overview, acknowledge alarm, drill down, intervene, and verify outcome.
seeds.remembered_reaction_or_critique: Overview supports situational awareness, while alarm floods and status-alarm confusion impair response; LOW confidence.
seeds.uncertainty: MEDIUM—pattern is stable, exact studies are not recalled precisely.
seeds.relevance_clue: Agent command surfaces should separate health, alerts, authority, and intervention evidence.
seeds.coding_agent_bias: Software dashboards may be reduced to green/red metrics and omit operator context.

seeds.observed_example: Sensitive operations use approval queues, two-person rules, and explicit acknowledge or deny actions.
seeds.problem_or_conditions: Require independent consent before high-risk or irreversible work proceeds.
seeds.enabling_technology_or_constraints: Identity systems, access logs, workflow software, and organizational separation of duties.
seeds.interaction_form: Receive request, inspect context, approve or deny, and escalate when blocked.
seeds.remembered_reaction_or_critique: Improves accountability but can produce approval fatigue, rubber-stamping, or harmful interruption pressure; LOW confidence.
seeds.uncertainty: MEDIUM—control pattern is familiar, operational effects vary.
seeds.relevance_clue: Autonomous actions need explicit consent boundaries and auditable refusal paths.
seeds.coding_agent_bias: Pull-request review patterns may obscure real-world availability, coercion, and urgency.

seeds.observed_example: Interfaces expose common actions first while placing advanced options, flags, and diagnostics behind details-on-demand.
seeds.problem_or_conditions: Serve novices without removing expert power.
seeds.enabling_technology_or_constraints: Layered menus, help systems, responsive layouts, and increasing feature complexity.
seeds.interaction_form: Use guided defaults, then open advanced controls or inspect details when needed.
seeds.remembered_reaction_or_critique: Reduces overload but hides power and creates leaky abstractions; MEDIUM confidence.
seeds.suspected_source_or_example: HCI teaching and recurring product-interface patterns.
seeds.uncertainty: MEDIUM—principle is canonical, examples are blended.
seeds.relevance_clue: Agent controls can provide safe defaults while preserving expert inspection and override.
seeds.coding_agent_bias: Coding agents tend to prefer shortcut-heavy expert paths and assume documentation access.

seeds.observed_example: Batch jobs, daemons, and later CI systems continue after submission and expose logs, status, and results.
seeds.problem_or_conditions: Run work that outlives an interactive session or operator’s constant attention.
seeds.enabling_technology_or_constraints: Schedulers, persistent storage, process supervision, logs, and notification systems.
seeds.interaction_form: Submit, detach, poll or subscribe, inspect evidence, and recover or retry.
seeds.remembered_reaction_or_critique: Frees operators from constant presence, but stale logs and orphaned work cause confusion; LOW confidence.
seeds.uncertainty: MEDIUM—general lifecycle is clear, examples span eras.
seeds.relevance_clue: Agent identity, state, evidence, and failure recovery must survive the chat session.
seeds.coding_agent_bias: Coding-agent training may equate process completion with successful task completion.

seeds.observed_example: Air-traffic and mission-control teams coordinate through shared displays, radio protocols, role assignments, and handoffs.
seeds.problem_or_conditions: Maintain shared situational awareness while multiple operators act under time pressure.
seeds.enabling_technology_or_constraints: Shared sensing, communication protocols, role separation, and procedural training.
seeds.interaction_form: Coordinate, acknowledge, hand off, challenge, and resolve conflicting interpretations.
seeds.remembered_reaction_or_critique: Structured callouts reduce ambiguity, while hierarchy and congestion can suppress dissent; MEDIUM confidence.
seeds.uncertainty: MEDIUM—coordination pattern is familiar, specific critique is generalized.
seeds.relevance_clue: Multiple agents need shared state, explicit handoffs, and preserved independent dissent.
seeds.coding_agent_bias: Software collaboration is often reduced to branches, tickets, and synchronous chat.

seeds.observed_example: Safety-critical and financial systems retain audit trails and provide expert review, override, or rollback paths.
seeds.problem_or_conditions: Verify automated decisions and recover after surprising behavior.
seeds.enabling_technology_or_constraints: Logging, provenance, access control, review workflows, and reversible operations.
seeds.interaction_form: Inspect evidence, question rationale, approve or override, and audit the result.
seeds.remembered_reaction_or_critique: Auditability supports trust, but post-hoc explanations can become reassuring theater; MEDIUM confidence.
seeds.suspected_source_or_example: Safety-critical systems practice and explainability literature.
seeds.uncertainty: MEDIUM—mechanisms are familiar, trust effects are interpretive.
seeds.relevance_clue: Agents need evidence, provenance, human override, and credible recovery after surprise.
seeds.coding_agent_bias: Training may treat tests and logs as sufficient proof while underweighting social trust.

seeds.observed_example: Cloud sync, push notifications, shared clipboard, and handoff let work move between desktop and phone.
seeds.problem_or_conditions: Resume work or respond to events while changing location or device.
seeds.enabling_technology_or_constraints: Cloud identity, push delivery, synchronized state, and small-screen limits.
seeds.interaction_form: Receive notification, inspect or respond on mobile, then continue on desktop.
seeds.remembered_reaction_or_critique: Convenient but fragmented; mobile often lacks context and can expose information accidentally; LOW confidence.
seeds.uncertainty: MEDIUM—continuity pattern is clear, reactions vary by implementation.
seeds.relevance_clue: Small-screen controls should support safe handoff without pretending to contain full context.
seeds.coding_agent_bias: Chat-based coding training may overstate continuity because text context appears portable.

coding_agent_bias_notes: CLI, terminal, repository, diff, test, and pull-request patterns are likely overrepresented in this recall.
Textual evidence and reproducibility may be privileged over embodiment, accessibility, social etiquette, and uncertainty.
Software lifecycle metaphors may distort physical, organizational, and cultural examples.
pack.uncertainty_summary: Overall MEDIUM. Canonical interface patterns are more reliable than exact dates, attribution, implementation details, and remembered reactions. No precise citations, quotations, DOIs, or URLs are asserted.
